correctness.rationale: All-character orthonormality is equivalent to two rank-one/rank-two Fourier zero conditions. Exact uniform-kernel moment counting yields first two q-nullity moments, and the pairwise-output character average is computed by rank 0/1/2 orbit counts. Two-point variance forces an inadmissible support value strictly between q and q², proving minimality. Vandermonde weights on ranks n,n-1,n-2 are strictly positive and satisfy both moments exactly for every prime power q and integer n≥2. Symbolic check and six complete small-prime-field exhaustions passed; these support but do not replace the analytical proof.

value.rationale: Exact Parseval sampling is a sharp natural design target for first-order additive Fourier sensing. The new theorem identifies and attains the universal minimum of three rank orbits for all finite fields and matrix sizes, distinguishes orbit sparsity from individual matrix-support sparsity, and gives strictly positive unique canonical weights. The strict no-two-shell obstruction and uniform all-parameter construction constitute a motivated structural finite-field harmonic-frame classification, not a routine isolated numeric invariant.
